CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 25, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.
PUBLIC COMMENT
6.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF CLEARMAN'S NORTH WOODS INN - It is recommended the City Council present Manager Stacy Burkhouse with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
6.1 Recognition of Clearman's North Woods Inn
6.2
50TH WEDDING ANNIVERSARY - It is recommended the City Council present William and Susan Savage with a 50th Wedding Anniversary certificate and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
6.2 50th Wedding Anniversary - William and Susan Savage
6.3
50TH WEDDING ANNIVERSARY - It is recommended the City Council present Steve and Mary De Ruse with a 50th Wedding Anniversary certificate and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
6.3 50th Wedding Anniversary - Steve and Mary De Ruse
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of June 11, 2019 and the minutes of the regular meeting of June 11, 2019.
7.1 June 11, 2019 SS Minutes
7.1 June 11, 2019 CC Minutes
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 25, 2019 in the total amount of $2,156,710.36.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
STATEMENT OF INVESTMENT POLICY - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Statement of Investment Policy of the City of La Mirada for Fiscal Year 2019-20.
7.3 Statement of Investment Policy
7.4
ANNUAL INVESTMENT REPORT AS OF MAY 2019 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Annual Investment Report as of May 2019.
7.4 Annual Investment Report
7.5
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING MAY 2019 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending May 2019.
7.5 Investment Report for the Month Ending May 2019
7.6
LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS FOUNDATION AGREEMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019-20 - It is recommended the City Council approve the Fiscal Year 2019-20 agreement between the City of La Mirada and the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts Foundation and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.6 La Mirada Theatre Foundation Agreement
7.7
ANNUAL REPORT OF THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Annual Report of the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts Foundation.
7.7 Annual Report for the La Mirada Theatre Foundation
7.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-08, LA MIRADA BOULEVARD AT IMPERIAL HIGHWAY AND IMPERIAL HIGHWAY AT TELEGRAPH ROAD TURN POCKETS PROJECT – ACCEPT THE FEE ACQUISITION AND TEMPORARY CONSTRUCTION EASEMENT AT 14885 TELEGRAPH ROAD - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to accept the fee acquisition and temporary construction easement on the property located at 14885 Telegraph Road (APN 8033-001-021) and authorize the City Clerk to execute the acceptance and process the deeds through Escrow to close the escrow process including recordation of the deeds and payment of compensation to the property owner.
7.8 CIP No. 2015-08
7.9
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-17, MEASURE I, PHASE 4, RESIDENTIAL STREET REHABILITATION – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Sequel Contractors Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
7.9 CIP No. 2015-17
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-17 ADOPTING THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2019-20 BUDGET - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 19-17 approving the Proposed Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget.
8.1 Resolution No. 19-17 Adopting the FY 2019-20 Budget
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-18 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019-20 - It is recommended the City Council select the California Per Capita Personal Income percentage change from the preceding year as the inflation factor for Fiscal Year 2019-20; select the growth of the County as the population factor for Fiscal Year 2019-20; and adopt Resolution No. 19-18 establishing an Appropriations Limit for Fiscal Year 2019-20 pursuant to Article XIIIB of the California Constitution.
9.1 Resolution No. 19-18 Appropriations Limit
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 19-19 REGARDING EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AND SALARY RATES FOR ALL CLASSES OF EMPLOYMENT, AND SUPERSEDING RESOLUTION NO. 18-13 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-19 regarding employment benefits and salary rates for all classes of employment, and superseding Resolution No. 18-13.
9.2 Resolution No. 19-19 Benefits and Salary Rates
9.3
RESOLUTION NO. 19-20 REGARDING PAYING AND REPORTING THE VALUE OF EMPLOYER PAID MEMBER CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-20 regarding paying and reporting the value of employer paid member contributions to California Public Employees' Retirement System.
9.3 Resolution No. 19-20 Employer Paid Member Contributions to CalPERS
9.4
RESOLUTION NO. 19-21 APPROVING THE INSTALLATION OF 25 FEET OF RED CURB ON THE EAST SIDE OF ARMSDALE AVENUE NORTH AND SOUTH OF RICHVALE DRIVE – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-21 approving the installation of 25 feet of red curb on the east side of Armsdale Avenue north and south of Richvale Drive.
9.4 Resolution No. 19-21 Approving Red Curb on Armsdale Avenue
10.
NEW BUSINESS
10.1
ACCEPTANCE OF SUBDIVISION AGREEMENT AND BONDS AND APPROVAL OF FINAL PARCEL MAP NO. 73574 - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the Parcel Map is categorically exempt under Section 15315, and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; authorize the Mayor to sign the Subdivision Agreement; authorize the City Clerk to accept and hold the bonds, as required in the Subdivision Agreement; and approve Final Parcel Map No. 73574.
10.1 Final Parcel Map No. 73574
SUCCESSOR AGENCY

AGREEMENT WITH THE WHOLE CHILD FOR HOMELESS PREVENTION AND RAPID REHOUSING SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council acting in its capacity as the Housing Successor Agency to the former La Mirada Redevelopment Agency approve an agreement with The Whole Child and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments on behalf of the City.
